page.title: Invoices & Bills
page.subtitle: What clients owe you, and what you owe vendors

list.differenceTitle: Gross minus payments and evidenced fees. Not assumed to be a fee.
list.showLinked: {count, plural, one {Show # linked entry} other {Show # linked entries}}
list.hideLinked: {count, plural, one {Hide # linked entry} other {Hide # linked entries}}
list.empty: Nothing yet. Add a receivable (client owes you) or a payable (you owe a vendor).

confirm.unlink: Unlink this entry from the invoice? The ledger entry itself stays.

toast.linked: {kind, select, FEE {Fee} other {Payment}} linked to {direction, select, PAYABLE {bill} other {invoice}}

edit.paidNote: Payments already recorded keep their amounts; the paid status is recalculated against the new total.

payment.title: Record payment — {label}
payment.intro: Adds the {direction, select, PAYABLE {payment} other {receipt}} to the ledger and links it to this {label}. Still open: {amount}
payment.shortfallNote: Enter what actually arrived. Any shortfall stays visible as an unmatched difference — it is never assumed to be a fee.
payment.vndPlaceholder: VND exactly as on the bank statement
payment.feeNote: Enter the amount this payment settles. If the bank withheld a fee, enter it too: the invoice is settled by the full amount, the fee is booked as an expense, and the account receives only the net. Without a fee, a shortfall stays open — it is never assumed to be a fee.
payment.feeDesc: Bank fee deducted from a receipt
payment.noFeeCategories: No expense categories — add one in Settings

link.title: Link a ledger entry — {label}
link.paymentHelp: Use this when one bank transfer covers several invoices, or the payment is already in the ledger.
link.feeHelp: Only a fee with evidence attached (bank advice or receipt) can explain part of an invoice. A difference on its own is never treated as a fee.
link.noChoices: No {type, select, INCOME {income} other {expense}} entries in {currency} with money left to allocate

errors.datesRequired: Issue and due dates are required.
errors.currencyLocked: Payments are linked in the current currency — unlink them before changing it.
errors.moreThanOpen: That's more than what's still open ({amount}).
errors.chooseAccount: Choose the account the money moved through.
errors.usdAccount: {account} is a USD account — this invoice is in {currency}.
errors.entryReversed: That entry has been reversed — link its correction instead.
errors.currencyMismatch: That entry is in {entryCurrency}; this invoice is in {currency}.
errors.receivableNeedsIncome: A receivable is settled by income.
errors.billNeedsExpense: A bill is settled by an expense.
errors.feeMustBeExpense: A fee must be an expense entry.
errors.feeNeedsEvidence: Attach the fee evidence (bank advice or receipt) to that ledger entry first.
errors.notEnoughFree: That entry only has {amount} left to allocate.
errors.postedUnlink: That payment is posted — only the owner can unlink it.
errors.ownerOnlyVoid: Only the owner can void an invoice.
errors.hasPayments: It has payments linked — unlink them first.
errors.feeInvalid: Enter the fee as an amount of 0 or more.
errors.feeReceiptsOnly: A deducted fee can only be entered for money received.
errors.feeTooLarge: The fee must be less than the amount settled.
errors.feeCategory: Choose the expense category for the fee.
errors.withheldFee: This bank fee was withheld from a receipt and is already part of that receipt's settlement.
